title: Love it !
text: Love it !. I know everyone loves to try new kitchen cooking things but I always say " do I really need another thing on my counter? " lol. I put off getting an air fryer thinking I could do the same thing with my toaster / convection oven. I heard so many people saying" oh I just threw it in the air fyer". Then I thought maybe there is something different about this thing. I was right ! I didnt have too hard of a time using it for the first time because the package gave the cooking time and instructions for cooking in the air fryer. I made french fries. They came out so crispy and I didnt use any oil at all. I have made a few other things since then and they came out good. I just need to learn more about the cooking times. This is small enough to put on top of a shelf. This size.is good for a single or 2 people.
